image_description: A close-up, high-resolution portrait of a male Mallard duck (drake) floating on water. The image focuses on the head and upper chest, showcasing the iridescent green head, yellow bill with a black tip, white neck ring, and chestnut breast. The background is blurred water.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bill is clearly visible, broad, flat, and yellowish-green with a dark tip, matching the description perfectly.
The eye is clearly visible and dark brown/black.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body appears robust and the plumage looks dense and smooth, consistent with a waterproof coat.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image displays the classic Mallard drake pattern: iridescent green head, distinct white neck ring, and chestnut breast.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The legs and feet are submerged or outside the frame in this close-up shot; they cannot be evaluated.
